title: Updating the outer counter
statement: For any register state and any natural number $z$, replacing its outer-counter field $a$ by $z$ gives a register-value vector equal to the vector obtained by replacing coordinate $2$ of the original vector by $z$.
replaced:
For a register state with register-value vector $v$, replacing the value of register $2$
by $z$ gives the same vector as updating its $2$nd coordinate to $z$.
